en.name: Prime: Freeze III
en.description: Condense the icy energy to a focal point and shoot it to freeze enemies in an instance. Afterwards, explode the condensed energy to freeze surrounding enemies again.
en.command: {KeyBind:MoveBack} + {KeyBind:GrabOrGuard} Hold {KeyBind:MoveBack} + {KeyBind:GrabOrGuard} or {KeyBind:Attack2} to perform an extra attack {KeyBind:Attack2} or {KeyBind:MoveBack} + {KeyBind:GrabOrGuard} after using skills of the same element (requires Prime: Elemental Flow) Can be added to a Quick Slot
tooltip: 37.02% damage in PvP only
